setup: CREATE TABLE b1_base AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS i FROM range(100000) t(i); CREATE VIEW b1_projected AS SELECT i + 1 AS x FROM b1_base WHERE i % 2 = 0; CREATE VIEW b1_s1 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_base; CREATE VIEW b1_s2 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s1; CREATE VIEW b1_s3 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s2; CREATE VIEW b1_s4 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s3; CREATE VIEW b1_s5 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s4; CREATE VIEW b1_s6 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s5; CREATE VIEW b1_s7 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s6; CREATE VIEW b1_s8 AS SELECT i + 1 AS i FROM b1_s7

workloads.name: b1_view_direct_control
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i + 1) FROM b1_base WHERE i % 2 = 0

workloads.name: b1_view_create
